start_frame: Closer than sh049 on the same low axis: her face brightening as she realises she is now the right size for the little door, the empty bottle still beside her at her exact height as the gauge.
end_frame: The same frame with one hand laid flat on top of her head, waiting, nervous — held still while nothing whatever happens.
constraint_honoured: 'The hand flat on the head is the whole performance; the nervousness is in the waiting, not in the framing.'
movement_note: 50 mm, not 28, because her face is large in frame at ten-inch scale — a wide lens this close to a child's face is the banned failure mode. LN-ep01-011 (5.1 s) sits whole in 7.0 s.
